svg.title: HarborCare end-to-end flow
svg.desc: Caller connects to a running listener, speech becomes text, verification runs, one synthetic workflow completes, response becomes audio, and session ends. Side callbacks handle questions and patient switching; a known switch-classification fault clears verification too early.
svg.text: HarborCare: one synthetic workflow per call
1. Phone or WebRTC connects to a running listener
on_call_start records the start and assigns the verify task.
2. Guava speaks a greeting and listens
Speech detection and speech recognition turn your voice into text.
The dialogue collects patient_id and verification_code.
3. Verification fields complete
on_task_complete("verify") calls backend.verify.
ID and code match?
No: deny access
Explain verification failed.
Speak result, hang up.
4. Collect one workflow choice
on_task_complete("choose") checks the verified session.
5. Run the selected synthetic workflow
Identity: confirm account. Insurance / claims / billing: read allowed records.
Appointments: collect an available slot, then backend.book checks it.
Payments: collect amount and consent; validate and simulate token payment.
Any invalid input, missing access or booking conflict returns a rejection.
6. Record outcome and tell caller
finish stores qa_result, journals a limited outcome and calls hangup.
Guava turns the closing text into spoken audio.
7. Session ends
on_session_end logs end reason and clears verified session access.
Side paths during the conversation
Questions: on_question returns the profile fallback; it does not query a clinical database.
Patient change: helper suggests switch_patient; execution starts fresh ID/code collection.
Known ROB-011 fault: the request handler clears verification before switch execution.
